results.content: When a supplier receives an invitation email to your invoice status portal, the supplier can access the invoice status portal from the link in the email. When suppliers click on the link to the invoice status portal, they will land on your invoice status portal sign in page. Suppliers can perform the following actions on the invoice status portal: [...] On the invoice status portal, a supplier can either look up the status of a single invoice or register on to your invoice status portal to view the status of the invoices the supplier has sent to you. [...] The invoice status portal is a self-service platform that allows suppliers to view the status and details of their invoices at any time. Suppliers can create a new account on your invoice status portal or use an existing account on SAP Business Network to view invoice details. Suppliers can also look up a single invoice without signing into your invoice status portal.
